row.proto: bool Career_Check_RecordSetContainsKind(void *alloc, void *key, void *set_owner, void *record, char kind)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Collects records for key via FUN_1407c6380 and returns true if any record id (short at rec+0x10->+8) exists in the hash set at set_owner+0x378 with kind byte (+0x10) equal to kind. Read-only membership test used by sponsor-update VM and facilities camera code. Level 1: semantics of the set not proven.
